turns.instruction:
Use OpenSees for the attached two-storey source-coordinate frame. Source Y is vertical. The conversion is Xg=Xs and Zg=Ys, but the sign in Yg=±Zs is missing. Confirm the mapping and local-axis interpretation before numerical reporting; transform geometry, supports, all force vectors and the equipment moment consistently. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at the highest roof beam-column joint with largest X and then largest Y; report global support My and Rz at the source-origin column base.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Confirm Yg=-Zs. Use the right-handed mapping (Xg,Yg,Zg)=(Xs,-Zs,Ys); apply it to force and moment vectors and reference directions as well as node positions and restraints. Thus the source +Ys equipment moment is global +Z, 6 kN.m. Analyze the confirmed model. Report global Ux, Uz and Uy at the highest roof beam-column joint with largest X and then largest Y; report global support My and Rz at the source-origin column base.
